cards.note: Corn fields can be found in most of northern Argentina, however they are most common in Córdoba, Buenos Aires and Santiago del Estero.
If you see vineyards with mountains in the west and flatness in the east, you are most likely in the outskirts of Mendoza.
Fields of sorghum can most commonly be seen in Santa Fe, Córdoba and Buenos Aires. It can be identified by its dark red flowerheads.
Sugarcane plantations are most common in Tucumán, with hotspots appearing in Salta and Jujuy.
Fields of sunflowers are mainly found in southern Chaco, and less commonly in Buenos Aires and southern Córdoba.
The majority of tree plantations in Argentina are located in the Entre Rios province.
Sugarcane plantations are very common in Northern Queensland, due to its tropical climate.
Coffee beans are by far the most common in Minas Gerais, but also can be found in Espirito Santo and northeastern Sao Paulo.
73% of Cotton Production in Brazil takes place in Mato Grosso. 20% take place in the western border of Bahia. Other minor spots are western Minas Gerais, Southern Goias and Northern MGDS

Eucalyptus Grandis, when fully grown, is a very tall tree with plantations all over Brazil. You can find them in both large and very small plantations, as well as randomly growing anywhere. You can see them all over the south, but there are some large plantations in Amapa too.
Soybeans appear as small, leafy soil grown plants. They are most commonly grown in Mato Grosso, Paraná, and Goiás.
Sugarcane plantations are by far most common in the state of Sao Paulo, and in the coastal north east states, especially Alagoas and Pernambuco.
Vineyards are commonly seen in Maule.
These palms where the crown has been cut, are very often found near Aracataca and some smaller towns North of it.
In general, banana plantation can be found mostly in Quindio and Magdalena, sometimes in Northwest-Antioquia and Cordoba, and rarely in surrounding provinces of Quindio.

Large amounts of banana plants in plantations are commonly found in different areas.

Paired with Cloudy Gen 3 Coverage, they're most common in Northwestern Antioquia.
In Magdalena you will often see banana plantations in a dry sandy/dirty area with mountains to your east.
In Quindio you will commonly find banana plantations behind hedges.

cards.a: Colombia - Agriculture - Banana - Small Field / No Hedge
cards.note: In the states surrounding Quindio you will find smaller banana plantations along the road not behind hedges.

The coffee belt stretches in the valley between Medellin and Cali. In the North, you will only find it near the Venezuelan border.

Olives and Tea have a very similar distribution.
Common Guava mostly appears in the valley between the western and the central mountain range in Colombia, but it can also appear in other valleys.
Guadua Bamboo plantations are found mainly in Caldas, but also in the adjecent Tolima, Quindio and Risaralda.
Oilpalms can be found mainly in Meta and Casanare. They are also very common around the 45 near Fundacion and Aracataca. Sometimes, you can find them in Barrancabermeja.
Sugarcane will mainly be found in Cauca and Valle de Cauca.

It is not so rare to see cows, horses, or sheep in France in Geoguessr. If that ever happens, you should consider the West of the country (Brittany, Normandy), as well as the mountainous regions (Pyrenees and Alps). This is where you have the most chances to find animals in France in Google Street View.
Corn fields are mostly located in the Western part of the country, as well as in some areas in the East of Paris, and around Lyon and Strasbourg.
Lavender fields can be found in the southeast, appearing as small grey bushes when not fully grown.

Salt farms, which appear as flooded trenches with grass medians, are unique to the west coastal islands of Île de Ré and Île d'Oléron as well as the nearby coast, as well as some very niche areas in the South of France (Camargue).
Sunflowers are mostly found in the southwest of the country, particularly around Toulouse.

France is the second largest wine producer in the world, with many famed wine regions. The most common include the area around Bordeaux, southern coast and Champagne, East of Paris. Other regions include, but are not limited to, Loire Valley, Alsace and Corsica.
Hop fields are mainly found between Ingolstadt and Landshut - an area called 'Hallertau/Holledau' in Bavaria. There are some minor regions in Thuringia, Saxony-Anhalt and Saxony as well.

There are 13 wine regions in Germany. They are mostly concentrated in the southwest of Germany. However, there are a couple regions further east as well, along the border between Thuringia and Saxony-Anhalt, as well as along the Elbe in Saxony.
The north east coast of Hawai'i Island is characterized by planted eucalyptus overlooking the ocean.
Within Assam, you can find corn between Guwahati and Nagaon, south of the river.
Within Assam, sugarcane is mainly found around Lanka
Within Bihar, tea plantations can be found in the far Northeast.
Canola is mostly found in and around Rajasthan.
Cotton is commonly found in the western parts of India, particularly in Gujarat and Maharashtra.
Maharashtra is by far the state with the highest grape production in India.
Within Madhya Pradesh, sugar cane can commonly be found southwest and northeast of the Satpura National Park.

Cotton (within) is mostly found around Nanded, more generally in the middle/eastern part of Maharashtra.

Note by MB: Very unreliable in my experience
Sugarcane in Maharashtra is mostly central from what I saw.
Oil palm plantations are almost exclusive to Andhra Pradesh and are mostly located around Eluru.
Pineapple is very uncommon in India, but if you see it, it's in Bihar in the corridor between Nepal and Bangladesh.
Sugarcane is most commonly found in the north in and around Uttar Pradesh, and in the southwest.

Sugar cane can be found in several areas, the two main ones being near Erode and Thiruvanamalai.

It is also findable in smaller areas between those two big areas, but it is still mainly a northern Tamil Nadu thing.
Within Assam, Tea is mostly planted in the eastern and in the southern regions. There are also some patches in Western Assam.
Tea plantations in India are mostly located in the northeast and in Kerala, but it spills in one particular area in Tamil Nadu northwest of Coimbatore
Within Tripura, Tea is found along the Bangladeshi border, and along the Assamese border.
Within West Bengal, tea plantations are found near the northern border to Bhutan.

Tea plantations can be found in the northeast and the far south.

NOTE: If you find tea plantations in a flat area, you are likely in Assam or northeastern West Bengal, near the Assam border.

Cotton fields in Telangana are logically next to the big area that produces the most of it in Maharashtra, so it is gonna be found mostly north-west of the state. You can click in Nizamabad for a good score.

Note by MB: In my experience, it's more common North of Nizamabad.

Cassava (Manihot esculenta) can be recognised by its small, hand-shaped leaves. It can be found both in plantations as well as semi-wild in residential areas. It is most commonly seen in Lampung and Java with Lampung being the main hot spot.
Within Indonesia, oil palm plantations are mostly concentrated in Sumatra and Kalimantan. Palm plantations can rarely be seen in Sulawesi.
The majority of rice production is concentrated in Java, but can sometimes be found in other provinces, namely South Sulawesi and South Sumatra. They can rarely be found in other provinces as well.
Agricultural fields with red soil are commonly found on several southern islands, most notably on the islands of Miyakojima and Ishigaki in southern Okinawa.

Rice is mainly produced north of Tokyo. During growth, it resembles straws of grass. And when ready for harvest, brown husks are visible. They are also commonly planted in beds of water.

The regions of Chubu (21%), Kanto (15%), Tohoku (27%), and Hokkaido (7%) make up the majority of production.
Sugarcane is almost exclusively found on the islands in southern Kyushu and Okinawa.

Green tea plants are often grown in hedged rows. You will often see these fans mounted on poles, which serve the purpose of preventing frost from falling on the plants.

The prefectures of Shizuoka (36%) and Kagoshima (34%) make up the majority of the production, with Mie (7%), Miyazaki (4%), and other prefectures (17%) making up the minority.

Commonly known as the blue agave, A. tequilana is immediately recognisable by its blue, sharply protruding leaves. This is the agave from which tequila is extracted, and it mainly inhabits Jalisco, where it is almost always observed in magnificent fields which can even coalesce into vast shades of blue from a distance.

Similar, but different: A. anguistifolia.

While it is difficult to distinguish them, A. tequilana is noticeably bluer. One other difference is that A. angustifolia is more commonly spotted in isolated groupings than A. tequilana, but expansive fields still exist.
These red agricultural fields surrounded by dense forests of tropical trees are most common in northern Campeche.
The area around Poza Rica in Veracruz features a lot of citrus tree plantations. It is common to see large amounts of these trees grown right on top of the hills.
Oil palm plantations are most common in Chiapas, and occasionally on the outskirts of the state in Veracruz, Tabasco, and Campeche.

In the northeast most area of State of Mexico, around the town Nopaltepec, they often farm Opuntia in vast plains. Farms of prickly pear are otherwise most commonly found in north east Morelos, where they foreground striking, sculpturally eroded dry hills. These farms can be found randomly elsewhere in the country, but much less commonly; if there is a third most common location for them it would be Guanajuato.

One will often notice scattered farms of A. salmiana, gatherings which stretch limitlessly in neat rows; these will almost always be found around the city of Pachuca in Hidalgo, and rarely more south-east.
Red agricultural fields are commonly seen in Zacatecas and occasionally southern Durango.
Sugarcane can be found all over the country, but by far most common in Veracruz.
Extremely dark fields are common in Guanajuato.
Similarly to sugar cane plants, banana plants are generally found in agricultural regions adjacent to the coast in the northern half of the country.
Olive tree plantations can be found in the far southern region of Tacna.

Most of the sugar cane production is found in the northern coastal regions of Peru near the cities of Chiclayo and Trujillo. Typically you see large fields of sugar cane in these areas. Smaller areas of sugar cane can be found further south in other valleys close to the Pacific coast.

Banana plantations are almost exclusively found in central and southern Mindanao.

NOTE: Wild growing banana plants can be found all over the country, so make sure what you are seeing is an actual plantation before guessing.
While corn can be found in most of the country, it is most common on northern Luzon and on Mindanao.
The vast majority of Oil palm plantations are found on Mindanao.
Pineapple plantations are mostly found on Mindanao.
The majority of sugarcane in the Philippines can be found on the islands of Negros and Panay.

Tree plantations that consist mostly of pine are common to the west of Eswatini, and some to the south in KwaZulu-Natal.

NOTE: Pine tree plantations are typically seen within the country of Eswatini itself.
Sugarcane plantations are most commonly seen in KwaZulu-Natal, mostly along the coast. However, they can also be seen in Mpumalanga on the Mozambique border. For an overview, see this map.
Vineyards are almost exclusively found in Western Cape, mostly in valleys near the coast. You can also commonly find them near Upington, in Northern Cape.
Banana plants are found around the city of Alanya.
Cotton is mainly found in the region surrounding the city of Şanlıurfa.
If you find yourself surrounded by greenhouses, you are likely to be along the south coast west of Adana.
Olive trees are mainly found on the Mediterranean coast.
Sunflowers are mainly found in northwestern Turkey.
Tea plantations are common in the province of Rize.
A majority of all vineyards in Turkey can be found in a region east of Izmir.
Along the Canadian border in North Dakota, and rarely Montana, fields filled with short yellow canola flowers (Brassica napus) can commonly be seen from the road.

cards.a: United States - Agriculture - Center Pivot Irrigation
cards.note:
You may have noticed some difference between farmland in different states on satellite view… It can be difficult to tell the farmland apart unless you’re at a corner up close, but as it turns out, the circles are actually created by a giant machine you can see from a distance

This is called centre point irrigation and can be found in many regions in the country!!

The most common states are Idaho, Nebraska and Kansas

Corn fields can most commonly be found in these regions:-Iowa

-North of Iowa

-Nebraska without NW

Cotton is a crop that produces large fields of fluffy white flowers. It is most commonly produced in coastal Southeast States, the Lower Mississippi River Valley, Western Texas, and parts of California and Arizona.

Agricultural golden fields can commonly be seen in eastern Washington.

NOTE: Flat areas of northern and eastern Oregon can have a similar appearance.

Rice production only occurs in a few areas of the US, so it is very useful for region guessing. It is typically grown in large, flat fields that resemble low prairies. It is only grown in north-central California and the Lower Mississippi River Valley in Arkansas, Louisiana, Texas, and Mississippi.

Soybeans are short, dark green crops organised in long rows and are found in similar regions where corn is grown. They are most common in the Eastern Plains, Midwest, Lower Mississippi Valley, and areas of the Mid Atlantic.
